reviews.x: The cutting blade is straight and not round as is shown in image.  Not as sharp either.  It seems the product is a cover up imitation.

I believe this product is a fraud and a misrepresentation of its origin. Although it states "made in Solengen Germany, the company is in Istanbul Turkey. The back of the packaging (not shown in the advertisement) is written entirely in Turkish language with Turkish email and physical address. Also, the product does not even remotely look like legendary Solengen Germany workmanship. I will be returning this item for refund.

Will not use to trim nails again, the cutting surface is straight  not curved so you spend a lot if time filing the edges left because of the design. Paced in my fishing tackle box to use on line etc. Crap, crap, crap, I missed the return window.
Very low quality nail clippers. The Chinese nail clippers are much higher quality for half the price.
These are the best nail clippers I've ever owned.

reviews.t: May be German made, but not of German quality!
reviews.x: These two Solingen Nail Clippers were supposedly made in Germany according to its insert, however, their qualities, IMHO, are not that of the usual Germany quality.  There are some design flaws with both clippers, though they are sharp enough to cut through paper, yet due to the angle of their blades (top and bottom), they had troubles cutting through nails (probably the angels of the two blades, not curvy enough).  In short, these clippers were no better than those that were made in China.  The

reviews.t: You Get What You Pay For
reviews.x: Many years ago, a very wise man told me the best steel in the world was produced in the US, Germany & Japan. All these years later, I still find that to be true.  I grew tired of using clippers that became dull after a few uses. Rather than keep using cheap clippers, I decided it was time to pay the price for good clippers. No regrets!  i am familiar with Solingen from some of their other products & have no disappointments from their clippers.  5-Star all the way.
Not sharp enough.  Disappointed with a brand I have trusted for so many years!
high quality as expected from a german company!

reviews.t: High quality as expected from an authentic Solingen
reviews.x: It does its job that you expect from Nail Clippers. Thanks to its sharpness , a single move is enough..
best I have ever owned - nails can not resist the power of these

These are easily the best clippers ever. I still have my little clippers from boot camp in 1984. They were the previous champs. Couldn't ever find their equal. These have clean cut, the pressure/ lever travel is just right. They feel well engineered.  And I had never found a large clipper I liked until this. Seems like a lot of words for nail clippers, but...I am fond of good steel. These are fine tools. Tools.

Item received was not the same as the one pictured. It was missing the nail file and chain on the smaller clippers. The edges of the clipper handles were also surprisingly sharp which seems like too obvious of an error for true German Manufacturing.

Both sizes of this nail clipper cut smoothly and cleanly without requiring too much force. I find the Solingen nail clippers excellent. Etched on the clippers is "Solingen, Germany" and "Stainless". Many reviews claim that the clippers are not made in Germany but the information on the package reads "Made in Germany". and distributed by TARKO based in Istanbul, Turkey. I have no way to determine what claims are true but the clippers work very well. I am satisfied with my purchase from Amazon

Bought these for my husband. I paid extra hoping for a better quality and it was worth it. They are definitely easier to use, more study, sharper than usual clippers. My husband actually “hid” them because he like them so much he didn’t want them to get lost in the household. I probably would take them!..lol

reviews.t: Knockoff product, unable to find on Solingen website
reviews.x: Claimed to be made in Germany in the ad and packaging... but this product is not on the Solingen website, and the packaging is all written in Turkish.  I believe this is a scam,  as the quality of the machining is poor.

The Cutter blades do not come together.  The small one has an under bite and the larger one has an over bite.  they do not make a clean cut.  they leave a ragged edge finger/toe nail that requires a lot of filing.
I actually bought these to throw in my tackle box to cut monofilament line. They’re also very good at clipping nails. I use them hard and they remain razor sharp. They’ll probably last forever
This is the second set I've ordered as gifts. Worth the money to get a quality set that cuts cleanly, with little effort.
Product is average Finish should be chromed Low quality package

I just tried our the finger nail clippers and they cut smoothly without leaving burrs or sharp points to catch on things like cheaper clippers tend to go.  They snick right thru the nail with minimal effort.  All in all I'm pleased.  If I had to find a complaint it would be that they don't have the toejam digger and file like other brands often have.  Not critical but certainly would be helpful.  My clippers packaging clearly states "MADE IN GERMANY". I'm not sure where the previous comments abo

I bought these nail clippers because they were made in Germany. I didn't try them out because it was a busy time of year  for me. Now I find I can't return them! I didn't realize that when I bought them. They are very heavy, more for a man then a woman. Also there is not the little nail file with pointed end for cleaning under nails, which I use as much as the clippers if not more!  I just want others to know what learned and not have to go through the same experience!

Normally, you can't get close to the nail on any tough cuticle snags. It was no problem with this set.  Things I have been trying to resolve are now no longer bothering me.  With all of the handwashing we do now dry skin allows for cuticles to snag on hair, clothing and other things.  Keeping the cuticle trimmed and neat is key to nail health. I can now manage my cuticle maintenance without a salon visit. Happy Clipping!!

It's hard to believe these are actually manufactured in Germany.  Getting a new cutting item shouldn't require a pass with some metal files and a knife sharpener to get them to have smooth, even cutting surfaces.  When you press the edges together there is a small gap, which causes sloppy cutting.  These are mediocre quality, at best.

These are very nice.  Great price and way better than any other ones sold.  Most are imports from China and they want just as much money.  These are very well made and sharp.  I was very impressed, don’t waste your money on cheap imports from China.  These are German made and the quality is exceptional.  Great price on amazon

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the clippers as high quality, sharp, and the best they have owned.
Several reviewers question the product's authenticity or German origin, suspecting it is counterfeit or misrepresented.
Some reviewers complain the blades are not sharp enough or have design flaws such as a straight rather than curved cutting surface.
A few reviewers describe the product as low quality and not worth the money.
